textNotes.text: ⚠️ PATCHED: some skips in this run no longer work. NEW post-patch 1.0.1 run (11 min) here 👉 https://youtu.be/WpvNjqVmpVM
⚡ NEW: Sub 10 min run with faster skips 👉 https://youtu.be/iu2SL4oyZFQ
13 minute full Kuldra run in RuneScape: Dragonwilds, post-patch. Follow along from start to kill with every shortcut and windstep skip. Use the chapters below to jump to the part you're stuck on.
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
0:20 Windstep shortcut
0:42 Anima pylon double jump dash
1:48 Windstep past necromancer phase
2:12 Garou windstep
2:44 Poison rat area skip (2 windsteps)
3:20 Waterfall area skip
4:35 Shortcut + windstep to Garou Thane (kill with melee)
5:15 Secret passageway to fire anima
7:50 Pipe shortcut
10:15 Final area windsteps to Kuldra's heart
- Pylon puzzle (9:19): if you accidentally stepped on any of the platforms while running earlier, step on all of them to reset, then do air, water, earth, fire.

textNotes.author: @sairentoeko
textNotes.text:
Small tip that may or may not make much difference.
Instead of using confuse on the archer at the black dragon, use surge instead. It'll confuse the dragon long enough to get to the earth anima and you won't get hit if you go where you did anyways.

in the 8min 40s, anyone got a bug where i couldn't activate the fire anima?

textNotes.author: @EdwardRichtofen_115
textNotes.text: I found another shortcut, at 2:43 you'll see the hole in the wall up top with some vines, you can windstep up and crouch through the gap, skips a few jumps, it takes you to where the zombie is caged at 3:28

textNotes.author: @eChuckNorris
textNotes.text: There's a faster skip after the Garou Thane. In the back corner there is a hole you can jump to and crouch through. A couple of jumps from here and you're at the abby demon. Cuts at least a minute off. You're also missing the skip after the abby demon that gets you direct over to the jump puzzle section past all the Thanes there. Saves another 2 minutes.
